_description: Phase 5 Tier 3 compatibility test — the ext-apps `threejs-server` MCP App. Real-world 3D scene renderer built on Three.js. Tests the CSP pipeline with external resources: Three.js loads from a CDN (unpkg.com or cdn.jsdelivr.net depending on the app's bundle), which requires resourceDomains widening in the iframe CSP. If the 3D scene renders AND the theme bridge applies (background/text colors), Phase 5 passes the strictest compatibility bar. Requires threejs-server running on http://localhost:3003/mcp and a matching MCP server entry in Settings → MCP Servers named 'threejs-server'.

components.text: Node MCP server on localhost:3003. The view is a Three.js 3D scene renderer. Tests the strictest compatibility bar — sandbox CSP must allow the app's declared resource domains, and the theme bridge applies to any non-WebGL UI chrome.
